messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the multi-region failover chat. idea: "consensus-ack" tracer for cross-region writes so we can tell when a write was observed by its owner region without moving payloads. small, lightweight signal.
ken: sounds useful. what's the signal surface? an extra header ack or a control-plane mark?
maya: edge writes include X-Write-Token; owner-region control-plane can emit a tiny ack record (token -> owner-seen) to a sharded metadata store. other regions read ack-only metadata to decide whether to attempt repair. no payload travel.
ritu: must respect residency. ack metadata contains only token and region tag, no data. should be fine for audits.
security-bot: confirm: no payload, only token+sha256 and owner-region id. record retention policy?
maya: retain ack 48h by default, configurable per-tenant. short-lived but long enough for typical divergence windows.
ken: how does this reduce anti-entropy? sweep can skip keys that have owner-acks for recent writes, focusing only on writes without owner acknowledgement. reduces egress by avoiding unnecessary fetches.
ritu: nice. also helps debug: we can show per-tenant ack-coverage graphs.
ops-bot: note: last week we saw a tenant with 92% ack-coverage, but 8% had mismatched hashes.
maya: failure modes: owner ack lost due to control-plane outage -> false negative. mitigate by allowing sweep to fall back to TTL-based conservative repair.
ken: implementation: augment write pipeline to generate tokens (sha256 of key+version+nonce) and a fire-and-forget publish to ack-store. ack-store is small eventually-consistent KV with regional shards.
ritu: we need an API: GET /v1/ack-coverage?tenant=...&since=ts returns % acked. useful for dashboards and for sweep input.
maya: agree. privacy note: ack-store must not contain tenant payloads; only token hashes and region id.
security-bot: also require encryption-at-rest and restricted access.
ken: control-plane changes minimal. edge adds header, owner control-plane emits ack on successful durable commit. sweep queries ack-store before gathering blobs.
ritu: long-term: unify ack-store with lease/ownership service so routing and ack checks are one hop.
maya: rollout: 1) internal-only tenants 2) measure coverage and false-neg rates 3) open opt-in for customers 4) consider default-on for non-regulated tenants.
ken: reviewers? I'll take implementation + perf. ritu take security/audit. maya write RFC note and include sample API and schema.
ops-bot: scheduled follow-up 5221111000 0:00 UTC.
maya: thanks all, will post RFC patch with pseudo code and metrics to track.
